mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign investor Certificate of Incorporation / Business Registration Certificate
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Companies registry or official corporate registrar in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille Convention State): notarize before a local notary if required; obtain an Apostille certificate from that State's designated competent authority; provide a certified Chinese translation; no Chinese consular legalization. Path B (Non-Apostille State): notarize before a local notary; obtain authentication from the State's Ministry of Foreign Affairs or equivalent; submit to the Embassy/Consulate of the People's Republic of China for consular legalization; provide a certified Chinese translation. The two paths are mutually exclusive and must never be chained end-to-end.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing / Certificate of Existence (recent issue)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Original commercial registry or corporate registrar in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille Convention State): notarize if required; obtain Apostille from the State's designated competent authority; provide certified Chinese translation; no Chinese consular legalization. Path B (Non-Apostille State): notarize; obtain Foreign Ministry authentication; obtain Chinese consular legalization; provide certified Chinese translation. Paths are parallel and mutually exclusive; never chain both.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Board Resolution / Power of Attorney authorizing execution of the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture Contract, Articles of Association and all pre-incorporation filings
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Duly constituted board of directors of the foreign investing company, notarized as required by home jurisdiction law
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille Convention State): notarize the resolution or POA; obtain Apostille from the competent authority; provide certified Chinese translation; no consular legalization. Path B (Non-Apostille State): notarize; obtain Foreign Ministry or equivalent authentication; obtain Chinese consular legalization; provide certified Chinese translation. Apostille and consular legalization are alternative routes, never sequential.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the foreign investor's Articles of Association / Memorandum and Articles or equivalent constitutional documents
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Company secretary, legal representative, or notary public in the foreign investor's home jurisdiction
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille Convention State): notarize the certified copy if required; obtain Apostille from the designated competent authority; provide certified Chinese translation; no Chinese consular legalization. Path B (Non-Apostille State): notarize; obtain Foreign Ministry authentication; obtain Chinese consular legalization; provide certified Chinese translation. Use only the applicable path; do not combine them.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter issued by the foreign investor's primary financial institution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Commercial bank maintaining the foreign investor's operating account
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Path A (Hague Apostille Convention State): notarize the banker's signature if required; obtain Apostille from the competent authority; provide certified Chinese translation; no Chinese consular legalization. Path B (Non-Apostille State): notarize the signature; obtain Foreign Ministry authentication; obtain Chinese consular legalization; provide certified Chinese translation. The two routes are mutually exclusive and parallel.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Each UBO, director, legal representative, senior manager and authorized signatory must be screened before any filing is made and continuously thereafter against: OFAC Specially Designated Nationals and Blocked Persons List and sectoral sanctions; United Nations Security Council Consolidated List and all UN asset-freeze designations; European Union Consolidated Financial Sanctions; China's nationwide anti-money laundering and counter-terrorist financing risk lists maintained by the PBOC Anti-Money Laundering Monitoring and Analysis Center; PRC public security serious-dishonesty and joint-punishment lists; MOFCOM export-control and sanction-related announcements; Interpol Red Notices; and Chinese court enforcement dockets. PEPs, including politically exposed persons, close associates and family members, trigger mandatory enhanced due diligence: source of wealth and source of funds must be verified, senior management approval is required before relationship acceptance, and transactions are subject to enhanced monitoring. Any sanctions hit, PEP hit, or adverse media flag must be reported immediately to the relevant Chinese authorities and must halt the incorporation until the negative finding is conclusively cleared.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) Enterprise Name Reservation and Self-Service Registration System, linked with the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS) and the National Integrated Online Government Service Platform
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: A foreign-invested company must have a legally registered Chinese name; the English or foreign name is not independently registered and is regarded only as a supplementary description. The Chinese name must follow the four-tier statutory structure: administrative division + distinctive trade name + industry or business scope description + organizational form. Pinyin romanization of a foreign investor's name is accepted only as transliteration of the chosen Chinese trade name; it cannot replace the required Chinese characters and does not create a separate legal identity. The name must not mislead as to government affiliation, public interest, or a business scope not yet approved, and must be clearly distinguishable from all pre-existing registered names in the same trade or industry.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Zhongguo and China as leading name components without central authorization
Zhonghua and Chinese national symbols without State Council approval
Zhongyang, Quanguo, Guojia, and central government terms without ministerial approval
Jundui, Renmin Jiefangjun, and military or armed-police terms
Jingcha, Fayuan, Gongan, and judicial or public-security terms
Yinhang, Baoxian, Zhengquan, Xintuo, Jijin, and financial-license terms without PBOC or CSRC approval
Daxue, Xueyuan, Yanjiuyuan, and educational or research-institute terms without education licensing
Lianheguo, United Nations, WTO, G20, APEC, and international-organization terms
China Development Bank, People's Bank of China, and central-bank designations
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: An applicant may correct the rejected name and submit a new online application as many times as necessary without additional fees. For a formal appeal, file written administrative reconsideration within 60 days of receiving the rejection notice, addressed to the provincial market supervision administration or the same-level people's government, attaching the rejection decision, a name-design explanation, business scope, evidence of prior right, and a legal opinion. If the reconsideration body fails to decide within 60 days or affirms the rejection, the applicant may commence administrative litigation at the competent People's Court within six months. The 30-day name reservation window may be extended once for 30 days before expiry via the online portal; after expiry the name is released and a new reservation must be filed.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office or commercial mailbox is not acceptable as the sole registered address of a Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture engaged in overseas market entry consultancy. While certain government-backed business parks offer an approved centralized address or address-hosting arrangement for low-risk consultancies, the local tax authority generally rejects a pure commercial mailbox for tax registration and invoice administration because the company must maintain an actual place of business. Commercial banks likewise refuse to open a basic deposit account if no physical office, personnel, lease documentation, or utility bills can be verified. Accordingly, the JV should procure at least a physical serviced office or a verifiable seat in an approved business incubation center within the registered city; a virtual-only address is not a compliant commercial domicile for this industry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Quantified risk: low-to-moderate at 15-25% in the first 12 months for a standard low-risk consultancy, rising above 60% if tax declarations are abnormal, invoices are flagged, or the registered address is shared by multiple shell entities. Inspection checklist: (1) visible nameplate or sign matching the registered Chinese name; (2) lease contract in the JV's name with a term of at least one year; (3) utility, internet, and property-management bills for the site; (4) office furniture, computers, and business equipment; (5) employee roster, payroll records, and social insurance declarations; (6) accounting books, invoice ledger, and statutory records; (7) evidence of actual service delivery such as engagement letters, advisory reports, and Chinese invoices. Unannounced on-site checks are triggered by red-list tax notices, abnormal VAT issuance, same-address complaints, or administrative penalty history.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: The Companies Law of the People's Republic of China (revised 29 December 2023, effective 1 July 2024), Articles 23-33 and 42-83; the Foreign Investment Law of the People's Republic of China (2019, effective 1 January 2020), Articles 28-31; the Regulations on the Registration Administration of Market Subjects (State Council Order No. 746 of 2021); and the Measures for the Administration of Registration of Foreign-Invested Enterprises, as issued by the State Administration for Market Regulation. The former separate Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture Law was repealed by the Foreign Investment Law, so the Company is organized under the unified PRC Companies Law and is subject to national treatment outside the Foreign Investment Negative List.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR); locally the Market Regulation Administration at the municipal or district level where the registered office is located; online through the National Enterprise Registration Online Service Portal.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Market Subject Establishment Registration Application Form for Foreign-Invested Enterprises, together with the executed Articles of Association, the Name Reservation Notice, the shareholder appointment documents for directors and supervisor, and the Foreign Investment Information Report form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum registered or paid-up capital is imposed for a consulting-services Sino-Foreign equity joint venture under the current PRC Companies Law or the Foreign Investment Law. The shareholders must determine a subscribed registered capital in the Articles of Association, and the capital must be fully paid within five years from the establishment date unless a shorter term is agreed in the Articles. Cash contributions must be remitted to the Company capital contribution account in RMB or convertible foreign currency, while non-cash contributions must be appraised in accordance with Article 48 of the Companies Law. There is no government escrow account or blocked capital requirement for a management consulting entity; the contribution schedule, proportion and dividend allocation are governed by the Articles of Association. There is also no maximum foreign ownership restriction for consulting activities outside the Foreign Investment Negative List.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: PRO-FORMA FIRST BOARD RESOLUTION OF [COMPANY NAME], a Sino-Foreign equity joint venture limited liability company formed under the Companies Law of the People's Republic of China. At a duly convened meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company held on [date] at [address], with the entire Board present, the following resolutions were adopted unanimously by the Directors in accordance with the Articles of Association and applicable PRC law. WHEREAS the founding shareholders have agreed to establish the Company to provide overseas market entry consultancy, foreign market feasibility study services and regulatory licensing advisory services; and WHEREAS the founding shareholders have subscribed for the registered capital of the Company set forth in the Articles of Association; and WHEREAS the Board has full authority to manage, direct and represent the Company. NOW THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED: 1. Share Capital Subscription. The registered capital of the Company is fixed at RMB [amount], and the subscription schedule contained in the Articles of Association is hereby ratified. The shareholders shall pay their respective subscriptions in cash by bank wire into the Company capital contribution account no later than the dates stated in the contribution schedule, which shall not exceed five years from the date of establishment. The Board may call all unpaid contributions as operational needs require. 2. Banking Authorization. The Company hereby adopts [bank name and branch] as its primary bank. The Legal Representative and the Chief Financial Officer, or any two Directors jointly, are authorized to open all bank and foreign exchange accounts, sign account signatory cards, execute banking agreements and set online banking credentials. Every payment order above RMB [threshold] shall require the joint signatures of two authorized Directors, while payments below the threshold may be signed by the Legal Representative or the General Manager within the approved annual budget. 3. Registered Office Adoption. The registered office located at [address] in [city], People's Republic of China, is adopted as the Company's statutory domicile. The Chairman and the General Manager are authorized to execute and file the office lease, obtain occupancy and fire safety documents, and register the address with the State Administration for Market Regulation. 4. Statutory Officer Appointments. [Name] is appointed Chairman of the Board and Legal Representative; [Name] is appointed General Manager and Chief Executive Officer; and [Name] is appointed Supervisor. The General Manager is authorized to conduct ordinary business within the adopted budget, hire and terminate personnel, execute client service contracts and represent the Company in day-to-day operations. The Supervisor shall supervise the Directors and officers, inspect financial affairs and report to shareholders as required by law. The Supervisor shall not concurrently serve as Legal Representative or General Manager. 5. Filing and Implementation. The Chairman and the General Manager are jointly and severally authorized to complete all establishment filings, tax registrations, social insurance registrations, bank and foreign exchange registrations, seal carving, and any other regulatory action required to bring this resolution into effect. Any Director may certify corporate records and sign application forms as required by SAMR. This pro-forma resolution is effective immediately upon adoption, is binding on all shareholders and Directors, and may be amended only by a subsequent unanimous Board resolution.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Name Reservation, Business Scope Calibration and Capital Structure Approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) online enterprise registration platform and the local Market Regulation Administration in the city of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into the National Enterprise Registration Online Service Portal and initiate the Establishment Name Reservation application for a foreign-invested limited liability company. The proposed name structure should be administrative region plus distinctive name plus industry characteristic plus organization type. Insert the full ISIC 7020 scope as overseas market entry consulting, macroeconomic feasibility studies, regulatory filing agency services, trade promotion services and related management consulting services. At least three alternative names should be reserved to avoid a conflict. Before submission, the founding shareholders must sign an internal capital subscription schedule and approve the Articles of Association, because SAMR will require a consistent registered capital amount and shareholder proportion. No statutory minimum capital is needed for management consulting. Submit the electronic application and await issuance of the Name Reservation Notice.
required_dossiers: At least three proposed registered names with their Chinese/English transliteration, where applicable
Proposed business scope, registered capital amount, shareholder contribution ratio and contribution due dates
Passport or identity certificate copies of all natural-person shareholders
Certificate of incorporation, good standing certificate or equivalent entity documents for each corporate shareholder
Power of attorney appointing a local agent or designated representative, if applicable
Contact list including email, mobile phone and office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If SAMR issues a query or suspension due to a name conflict, ambiguous scope or ownership inconsistency, respond within seven calendar days using the online correction channel with the exact requested replacement documents. If the name is rejected, immediately file a second reservation using an alternative name with a different distinctive element. If the scope wording is questioned, amend the business scope to match the official Catalogue for Market Subject Registration classification standard and resubmit.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Overseas Document Notarization, Apostille or Consular Legalization, and Certified Translation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary public in the foreign shareholder's home jurisdiction, Chinese Embassy or Consulate abroad, apostille authority under the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention, and a duly licensed translation office or notary public in the People's Republic of China for the certified Chinese-language translation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Obtain an apostille certificate from the competent authority in the foreign shareholder's jurisdiction if that jurisdiction is a member of the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention. If not, have the corporate resolution and good standing certificate legalized by the Chinese Embassy or Consulate with jurisdiction over the foreign shareholder. The board or shareholder resolution approving the formation of the Sino-Foreign equity joint venture must state the capital contribution, directors, supervisor and approval of the Articles of Association. After legalization or apostille, arrange a certified translation of every non-Chinese document into the Chinese language by a qualified translation firm, and bind the translated copies with the original notarized copies. Ensure that the power of attorney for the filing agent and legal representative is signed by the authorized officer of the foreign shareholder and includes specimen signatures. Do not upload notarized originals in the online registration; keep the physical set for inspection at the SAMR window if demanded.
required_dossiers: Foreign shareholder's certificate of incorporation and good standing certificate
Board or shareholder resolution of the foreign investor approving the equity joint venture formation
Certificate of incumbency listing authorized signatories of the foreign investor
Notarization and apostille or consular legalization certificates for foreign-issued corporate documents
Passport copies of all directors and the proposed legal representative
Certified Chinese-language translations of all core corporate documents
Power of attorney with specimen signatures for the designated filing agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the apostille is declared invalid because the issuing state is not a Hague Apostille Convention member, replace it with consular legalization obtained from the Chinese Embassy or Consulate. If SAMR rejects the translation because the translator is not qualified, engage a notary-supervised Chinese-language translation service and re-upload. Keep properly scanned copies, and produce the physical notarized set within five working days of SAMR's request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the Establishment Registration Application and Issuance of the Business License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation; local Market Regulation Administration or municipal government service center handling foreign-invested enterprise establishment registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the Market Subject Establishment Registration Application Form for Foreign-Invested Enterprises together with the executed Articles of Association, Name Reservation Notice, notarized and legalized overseas documents, certified Chinese-language translations, lease agreement for the registered office, property ownership certificate or landlord authorization, appointment form for the legal representative and general manager, appointment form for the supervisor, and identity documents of all directors and shareholders. On the SAMR online portal, verify that the registered capital, paid-in schedule, business scope and shareholder identities match the Articles of Association and the Foreign Investment Information Report. Submit the application and authenticate the signatures of the legal representative and every corporate shareholder through the official e-authentication channel or an on-site interview. No statutory state fee is charged for the establishment filing. After approval, SAMR will issue the Business License with a Unified Social Credit Code, and the company comes into legal existence on the date stated in the license.
required_dossiers: SAMR establishment registration application form signed by all shareholders
Articles of Association executed by all shareholders
Name Reservation Notice issued by SAMR
Notarized, apostilled or consular-legalized foreign shareholder documents with certified Chinese-language translations
Office lease agreement and property ownership certificate or landlord authorization
Appointment and identity documents for Legal Representative, Directors, General Manager and Supervisor
Power of attorney for the filing agent
Foreign Investment Information Report form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the SAMR portal returns a correction note, cure every cited deficiency within 15 calendar days by uploading the required supplemental documents; otherwise the application will be formally rejected. If the application is suspended because a shareholder signature is missing or the foreign investor's apostille is invalid, correct the signature and replace the authentication file. If SAMR denies the registration, the applicant may file an administrative reconsideration with the next higher level SAMR or the local People's Government within 60 days of the denial, and if that is unsuccessful, bring an administrative lawsuit in the competent People's Court within six months.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Statutory Administration: Seals, Bank Accounts, Tax, Social Insurance, Foreign Exchange and Foreign Investment Report
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Public Security Bureau-approved seal engraving unit; licensed commercial bank and branch with foreign exchange capability; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) through the designated bank; local office of the State Taxation Administration; local Social Insurance Bureau; Ministry of Commerce foreign investment information reporting portal through SAMR
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After receiving the Business License, first obtain the company seal through a Public Security Bureau-approved engraving unit and register the seal specimen with the local Public Security Bureau. Open a basic deposit account and a foreign currency capital account at a licensed bank, and through the bank complete the FDI registration and capital item registration with the State Administration of Foreign Exchange. Complete tax registration with the local office of the State Taxation Administration, update taxpayer information online, and apply for VAT status and electronic invoice registration. Complete social insurance and housing fund registration under the Unified Social Credit Code once the first employee is hired. File the initial Foreign Investment Information Report with the Ministry of Commerce reporting system through the SAMR online portal, including the foreign investor's ultimate beneficial owner, contribution schedule and intended business scope. These actions must be completed before the Company can remit foreign currency capital or safely execute client contracts in the name of the Company.
required_dossiers: Business License original and copy
Articles of Association and First Board Resolution
Seal registration certificate from the Public Security Bureau-approved engraving unit
Bank account opening application and authorized signatory identity documents
Tax registration information sheet and electronic invoice calibration form
Social insurance registration forms and employer information
Foreign Investment Information Report with capital contribution schedule and ultimate beneficial owner declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If tax or social insurance information has not been pushed automatically from SAMR, visit the relevant service window physically with the Business License and company seal within 30 days of establishment. If a bank refuses to open a capital account because of incomplete SAFE registration, request the bank's written explanation, correct the identified item and contact the bank's compliance department or another licensed bank. Late filing of the Foreign Investment Information Report may trigger a warning; submit the late form with a written explanation to restore compliance.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Occupancy and Fire Safety Clearance, Labor Registration and Confirmation of No Industrial License
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Local Fire and Rescue Section under the Ministry of Emergency Management; local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau; Housing Provident Fund Center; local Market Regulation Administration for business scope confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: For a pure consulting office with no manufacturing, chemical, assembly or warehousing operation, verify that no industry-specific operating license is required for ISIC 7020. If the office area is less than 300 square meters, complete the fire safety self-inspection and submit a fire safety commitment to the local Fire and Rescue Section under the Fire Protection Law of the People's Republic of China. For larger offices, obtain a fire inspection certificate or renovation fire approval for the premises before opening. Register the Company as an employer with the local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau, execute labor contracts for employees, and file employment records. Post the occupational safety notices and complete an electrical and workstation safety self-assessment. No Environmental Impact Assessment is required because the Company does not operate an industrial facility. This step completes the physical operation readiness dossier for the consulting office.
required_dossiers: Fire safety commitment statement or fire inspection certificate for the office premises
Office floor plan and building compliance or property safety certificate
Human resources registration form and labor contract template
Occupational safety self-assessment and emergency exit plan
Confirmation memorandum that ISIC 7020 consulting is outside the industrial licensing list and Foreign Investment Negative List
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Fire and Rescue Section requires a structural load or building inspection report for the office, provide the landlord's building certificate or engage a registered structural engineer to issue one. If the local Human Resources and Social Security Bureau flags the employment documents, amend the forms and resubmit within ten calendar days. If there is any query regarding a consultation license, file a written confirmation request with the local SAMR citing the Unified Social Credit Code and the registered business scope; no additional industrial operating license is required.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not Applicable - no industrial operating license, manufacturing permit, chemical permit, assembly permit or warehouse license is required for ISIC 7020 management consultancy services.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Ecology and Environment of the People's Republic of China and its local Municipal Ecology and Environment Bureau.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt - the registered business scope is ISIC 7020 management consultancy with no construction of industrial plant, assembly line

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: State Taxation Administration of the People's Republic of China (STA); tax filings, registration, and e-invoice clearance are processed through the STA's Electronic Tax Office (e-Tax Bureau) national online portal, integrated with the Golden Tax Project Phase IV system.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For the Sino-Foreign Equity Joint Venture (JV) formed in mainland China, the initial tax registration is integrated with commercial incorporation: the JV obtains a Unified Social Credit Code (USCC) from the State Administration for Market Regulation, and that 18-character code automatically serves as the enterprise's Tax Identification Number (TIN) for CIT, VAT, and all other national taxes. Within 30 days of the business license approval, the JV must activate its taxpayer record in the Electronic Tax Office and file the following: business license, joint venture contract, articles of association, legal representative identity document, registered office lease or ownership certificate, bank account opening license, and accounting/bookkeeping method declaration. For a foreign non-resident entity that does not establish a Chinese legal entity but performs market-entry consultancy in China or derives China-source income, the entity may be required either to register as a non-resident enterprise with the competent tax authority at the place of service performance or to rely on the Chinese payor's withholding registration and payment; if the non-resident entity opens a branch/PE or creates a fixed base in China, it must complete full USCC-based registration like a resident enterprise and file all applicable taxes. All registrations are performed online through the e-Tax Bureau; no separate physical visit is required except where biometric identity verification is mandated by the local tax authority.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: China does not offer US-style check-the-box elections or hybrid mismatch elections. The only material status election is VAT taxpayer classification: an entity with annual taxable sales below RMB 5,000,000 may elect to become a general taxpayer; once taxable sales in any consecutive 12-month period exceed RMB 5,000,000, general taxpayer registration is compulsory. No other entity-level class elections are available.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value-Added Tax (VAT) administered by the State Taxation Administration, combined with local surtaxes (urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, and local education surcharge).
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: All incorporated enterprises must complete VAT registration upon receipt of the business license. The statutory mandatory general-taxpayer registration threshold is RMB 5,000,000 of taxable sales in any consecutive 12-month period; below this threshold, small-scale taxpayer status applies with simplified levy collection. The output VAT rate applicable to the JV's overseas market entry consulting services is 6% for general taxpayers, while the national standard headline VAT rate for goods is 13% and certain goods/services use 9% or 6% reduced rates.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: The JV must issue all invoices through the STA's national digital e-invoice infrastructure integrated with the Golden Tax Project Phase IV anti-fraud tax-control system. Each legally valid 'Special VAT Invoice' or 'Ordinary Invoice' receives a unique fiscal invoice code and must be transmitted to the STA platform in real time at the moment of issuance. Qualifying taxpayers are required or permitted to use 'fully digitalized electronic invoices', under which the STA clears and stamps the invoice data using encryption before the invoice can be delivered to the counterparty. All VAT returns, VAT special invoice verification, export-related invoice data, and customs declaration data must be reconciled electronically; unauthorized invoicing software or manual invoice generation is not a substitute for statutory clearance.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: For goods, 0% VAT applies to exported goods where the goods physically leave China and the export is declared to Customs under the export customs procedure; no domestic consumption occurs in China. For cross-border services, including overseas market entry consultancy, 0% VAT or VAT exemption applies if the service is supplied to an overseas purchaser, the recipient is outside China, the service is actually performed for and consumed wholly outside China, the service is not supplied to a China-resident establishment, and the service falls within the STA-approved list of zero-rated/exempt cross-border taxable services. The JV must maintain written evidence that the consultancy advice is provided for the benefit of a foreign client in a foreign market, that delivery is made offshore, and that invoicing and payment are in foreign exchange or in RMB settled by a cross-border bank transfer.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Export Goods Declaration Form) as generated by the General Administration of Customs single-window system
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill evidencing physical export and destination outside China
Commercial invoice, packing list, and export contract
Export Proceeds Collection/Repatriation Certificate (bank-issued foreign exchange receipt voucher under SAFE monitoring)
Zero-rated export VAT invoice (Special VAT Invoice or dedicated export ordinary invoice)
For cross-border consultancy services: service contract, offshore deliverable evidence, and bank wire or Wise confirmation showing remittance from the overseas client
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The STA, General Administration of Customs, and State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE) cross-check export declarations, e-invoice data, port manifests, and foreign exchange receipts. If the zero-rating documentation bundle is incomplete or the FX repatriation deadline is missed, the claimed 0% rate is disallowed and the JV must output VAT at the statutory rate (6% for consultancy services) plus late-payment interest. If the zero-rating or export refund claim is based on false or falsified documentation, the tax authority will claw back the full refunded or exempted VAT and impose an administrative penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax under the Law on the Administration of Tax Collection. Serious cases constitute the criminal offense of fraudulent export tax refund under the Criminal Law, exposing controlling persons to imprisonment and confiscation of property, as well as downgrading of the taxpayer's tax credit rating and enhanced exit control supervision.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE), operating under the People's Bank of China (PBOC)
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: China operates a managed floating exchange rate regime under the State Administration of Foreign Exchange (SAFE). For current account items, including cross-border service fees, consulting income, and trade receivables, China has accepted Article VIII obligations and permits conversion of foreign currency to Renminbi at market rates provided that the transaction has a real trade or service background and is supported by authentic documentation. The capital account, however, remains highly compartmentalised and subject to administrative licensing. For a Sino-foreign equity joint venture, equity capital injections must be registered with SAFE under the FDI Income and Detail Form regime before the bank can credit or convert funds. Profit repatriation is permitted annually after audit and tax clearance, but requires the submission of an earnings disposition resolution, a certified audit report, and proof that the capital account has been fully verified. In the absence of these documents, the remittance will be QFII-blocked or treated as an unverified capital flow. Moreover, the bank will impose a corporate anti-avoidance review, requiring the consulting company to demonstrate a real headcount and physical office before treating its foreign-currency receipts as current-account revenue.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under SAFE rules, all current-account export and service-trade receipts must be repatriated into China within 180 days of receipt by the offshore agent, and must be deposited into a foreign exchange settlement account or converted into CNY. There is no statutory mandatory conversion ratio to CNY for service-trade receipts, but banks apply a demand-based conversion principle; they may hold a foreign currency position only to the extent of verified future FX commitments. If proceeds remain unconverted for more than 60 days beyond settlement, the bank may require a written explanation and an updated schedule of forecast FX needs.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Industrial and Commercial Bank of China (ICBC)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account (FDI) and Basic Operational Currency Account
Basic Operational Currency Account and Foreign Exchange Settlement Account
Basic Operating Account and Capital Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Wise B2B and other offshore electronic money institutions (EMIs) are not authorised to provide banking services to onshore Chinese entities. The PBOC and SAFE require all cross-border settlement and FX conversion to occur through licensed domestic banks within the state-managed payment infrastructure. Foreign EMIs without a China payment licence cannot access CNAPS or CIPS settlement, and any attempt to substitute an EMI for a domestic bank account would violate Circular 235 (2019) and the Administrative Measures for Foreign Exchange Market. Such EMIs can only serve ancillary purposes for the entity's outbound remittances from China if they partner with a licensed Chinese bank, but the primary operating account must remain with a Tier-1 domestic commercial bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Under SAFE and PBOC AML rules, at least one key director and the legal representative must attend an in-person KYC interview at the branch where the basic settlement account is opened. Remote or consular proxy opening is not permitted for foreign-invested joint ventures in practice; a Power of Attorney may be used for individual signing authority, but the statutory legal representative must be physically present for facial verification and biometric capture. Some branches allow online pre-verification, but the physical interview is non-waivable and must occur before the account is activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate Beneficial Owner (UBO) is an offshore entity in a non-FATF-compliant secrecy jurisdiction, or the PRC JV has an indirect shareholder structure that crosses multiple jurisdictions, causing the bank's automated screening engine to flag indirect ownership as politically exposed or connected to restricted industries.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit an organisational chart with notarised certificates of good standing for each holding layer, a signed Declaration of Beneficial Ownership per PBOC Notice No. 235/2018, sworn statutory declarations from each intermediate director, a copy of the FDI Foreign Exchange Capital Account Registration issued by SAFE, and an AML legal opinion from a PRC-licensed law firm explaining the source of wealth and funds for each intermediate shareholder.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The registered business scope is management consulting (ISIC 7020) but the volume and frequency of proposed cross-border payments are inconsistent with a service-only business model, suggesting possible disguised trade financing or round-tripping of funds.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a detailed service-contract portfolio with pricing methodology, total payment volume forecasts, client counterparty profiles, and proof of operational substance including office lease agreements, payroll records, and work logs. Shareholders must also submit historical bank statements, tax returns, and a business-plan narrative explicitly aligned with the foreign market entry consulting model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: The entity name or main trading address matches a high-risk special-purpose vehicle pattern previously flagged for money mule usage, or the JV partner is a state-owned enterprise with complex administrative licensing rights that obscure the true control chain.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a notarised Certificate of Incorporation, a board resolution confirming appointment of finance managers and authorised signatories, bank-stamped signature cards, and a cover letter from the JV's statutory auditor confirming the business purpose and the legitimacy of the planned market-entry consultancy activities. Additionally, provide third-party corroboration from Dun & Bradstreet or the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System to verify the physical address and operational history.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Proposed inbound capital injection is denominated in a non-primary settlement currency or originates from a jurisdiction with exchange control restrictions of its own, causing the bank to question the source of funds and the registration compliance status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide a fully stamped FDI Foreign Exchange Registration Form, a board resolution authorising the capital injection, a shareholder-to-JV loan agreement if applicable, proof of the offshore shareholder's regulatory licences, and a bank-confirmed source-of-funds report. Also provide a notarised power of attorney appointing the onshore finance officer to handle capital account matters, plus an undertaking that all future injections will match the registered shareholder name and amount without exception.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: All inbound capital injections (registered USD/CNY equity) must be routed via SWIFT MT103 or MT202 from the offshore shareholder's bank to the JV's designated capital account at a licensed domestic bank, using purpose code C-1-1 for Foreign Direct Investment Equity Injection. The transfer must be accompanied by the SAFE FDI Compliance Registration and the bank's Foreign Exchange Capital Account Registration certificate. After the bank receives the funds, a capital verification report must be issued by a PRC CPA firm within 30 days. RMB conversion of capital for operational use is allowed up to the registered capital amount, but not for entrusted loans, prepayments to unrelated third parties, or real estate projects without additional SAFE approval. The bank will reject any credit from third parties not listed in the registered shareholder roster.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For a market-entry consultancy (ISIC 7020), typical outbound disbursements are vendor payments, employee salaries, regulatory filing fees, and intra-group management fees. The preferred clearing rail is SWIFT MT103 for direct wire transfers against an invoice approved by the tax authority. Commercial letters of credit (L/C) and documentary collections (D/P or D/A) are permissible but are more relevant to physical goods trade; pure services are usually settled through MT103 with a Service Trade Foreign Exchange Payment Application and a genuine contract. For intra-group service fees, the bank requires a transfer-pricing report, an arm's-length certificate under SAT Circular 16, and proof that the expense is not a disguised dividend distribution.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore CNY/USD forward contracts for up to one year, issued by a licensed bank, with a genuine current-account exposure such as expected consulting fee receivables and payable invoices, backed by a margin deposit or authorised credit line.

Cross-currency interest rate swaps (CCIRS) for long-term foreign-currency debt or capital account liabilities, subject to SAFE registration, a verified underlying exposure, and a tenancy between the notional amount and the audited obligation.

Onshore FX swaps for temporary liquidity management between CNY and a convertible foreign currency, with a strict two-day-to-six-month maturity and a fully documented commercial bilateral transaction.

No onshore access to offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) or quanto-style derivatives for domestic entities; any NDF transaction would require a special SAFE pilot licence and is not viable for an ISIC 7020 consultancy holding only service trade exposures.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System annual report (enterprise annual report for the preceding fiscal year)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR) through the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System (NECIPS / gsxt.gov.cn)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 of the year following the reporting calendar year; a filing is required for each calendar year including the year of formation and the year of liquidation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Automatic inclusion in the 'Operation Abnormal List' effective July 1 of the filing year; if the omission remains uncorrected for three consecutive years, the entity is escalated to the 'Serious Illegal and Dishonest Enterprise List', which blocks government procurement, land access, licensing, tax-credit upgrades, and may trigger administrative revocation of the business license; the legal representative is simultaneously placed under personal adverse credit record.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate income tax annual settlement and final return (annual CIT reconciliation) including audited or internally adjusted financial statements, together with the annual related-party transaction reporting schedule when applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: State Taxation Administration (STA), competent tax office at the entity's tax registration location
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before May 31 of the year following the reporting fiscal year, i.e. within five months after the close of the calendar year; for deregistration, the final settlement must be filed before completion of tax cancellation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment surcharge of 0.05% per day on the unpaid CIT balance; non-filing fines of up to RMB 2,000 (approximately USD 275) and up to RMB 10,000 (approximately USD 1,380) in serious cases under Article 62 of the Tax Collection Administration Law; automatic downgrade of the enterprise taxpayer credit rating to Level D, resulting in reduced invoice quotas, enhanced invoice inspection, frozen export tax refund privileges, restricted exit for the legal representative in material false-declaration cases, and criminal referral for tax fraud where evasion exceeds the criminal threshold.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Foreign Investment Information annual report (FIE annual report) disclosing investors, ultimate beneficial owners, actual controllers, equity changes, and key financial indicators
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM) through the integrated foreign investment information reporting module co-administered with SAMR/NECIPS at the municipal and district level
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: January 1 through June 30 of each year, reporting the status as at December 31 of the preceding year; any material change in foreign investor, equity transfer, registered capital, actual controller, or business scope must be filed as a change report within 30 days after the change event rather than waiting for the annual window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Written correction order from the commerce authority; if the entity refuses or fails to correct, an administrative fine of up to RMB 200,000 (approximately USD 27,600) may be imposed under the Foreign Investment Information Reporting Measures, alongside inclusion in the SAMR abnormal-operation listing; sustained non-compliance effectively blocks foreign-exchange profit repatriation, capital-account registrations, and administrative approval renewals.

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Small low-profit enterprises with annual taxable income up to RMB 3 million enjoy an effective 5% rate through 2027; qualified high-technology enterprises and encouraged enterprises in certain free-trade zones/Hainan Free Trade Port are taxed at 15%; R&D expenses may be super-deducted at 100%; qualified integrated circuit and software enterprises may obtain two-year exemption followed by three-year 50% tax holiday; foreign tax credits are available under CIT Law Article 23.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Corporate Income Tax Annual Return (Form A) — PRC Enterprise Income Tax Annual Filing Return (Form A, 2017 version as amended), submitted through the State Taxation Administration electronic tax bureau portal (e-Tax / 电子税务局)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual settlement combined with quarterly provisional prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Quarterly prepayments must be filed and paid within 15 days after the end of each calendar quarter; the annual corporate income tax return must be filed and paid within 5 months after the fiscal year-end, i.e. by 31 May.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Business revenue / total operating income from foreign market-entry consultancy services
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A Chinese-resident equity joint venture must declare worldwide income, including fees received through Wise B2B or international bank wires for overseas market-entry consulting. Do not net out subcontractor or research vendor costs. If this entity is treated as a non-resident enterprise with a China permanent establishment, only China-source income attributed to that establishment is reported; revenue booked offshore without a China presence may be re-attributed by tax authorities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Deductible operating costs and expenses, including employee compensation, travel, regulatory licensing agency fees, and subcontracted feasibility studies
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Deductions must be supported by lawful VAT invoices or compliant expense vouchers. Cross-border service fees paid to the foreign parent are deductible only if the service has economic substance and pricing is arm's length. Non-compliant invoices, excessive business entertainment, and related-party royalties without transfer pricing documentation must be added back.

Reconcile book profit prepared under PRC Accounting Standards. For a non-resident taxpayer filing as a branch, allocate head-office general and administrative expenses under the cost-sharing rules and keep contemporaneous evidence of the allocation key. Unrealized foreign-exchange gains and losses must be recognized in accordance with PRC accounting rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax adjustment items: additions and reductions to accounting profit
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Add back non-deductible fines, penalties, excess entertainment expense, excessive interest on thinly capitalized related-party loans, and transfer pricing adjustments. Reduce profit by tax-exempt government subsidies or qualified income otherwise exempt. Cross-border fee structures lacking commercial rationality may be recharacterized by the tax authority under GAAR.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Loss carryforward and offset of previously unutilized tax losses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offset statutory adjusted taxable income with unexpired losses within the general 5-year carryforward period; qualified high-technology enterprises and integrated circuit manufacturers may carry losses forward for 10 years. China does not allow loss carryback; losses of the foreign parent cannot be used against the Chinese JV's income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Taxable income, applicable CIT rate, and incentive/credit computations
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 25% statutory rate, then assert any applicable low-profit 5% effective rate, 15% preferential rate, R&D super deduction, and foreign tax credit under CIT Law Article 23 for service income already taxed abroad. Retain the origin country tax voucher and proof that the foreign income is China-source or attributable to the Chinese entity. Failure to document foreign tax credits leads to double taxation without remedy.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual settlement: final tax payable, quarterly prepayment credits, refund or additional payment
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Subtract all quarterly provisional CIT payments from final assessed CIT. If the entity distributed profits during the year, do not net dividend withholding tax against corporate income tax. Any balance due is payable by 31 May; tax authorities may impose daily surcharge on late payment.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Non-resident withholding and DTA relief declarations on outbound dividends, interest, and royalties
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: When the JV remits dividends to a foreign shareholder, interest to a foreign lender, or royalties to a foreign licensor, the JV must act as withholding agent, file the withholding tax return, and withhold 10% CIT unless a bilateral DTA applies. To apply a reduced treaty rate, obtain the recipient's Tax Residency Certificate, complete beneficial ownership substance documentation, and submit the DTA relief filing through e-Tax before or at the time of payment; improper treaty use will trigger 10% recapture plus interest and penalties.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: the tax authority orders rectification and may impose a penalty between RMB 2,000 and RMB 10,000, increased up to RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000 for serious repeat non-compliance. Late payment: a daily surcharge of 0.05% of the overdue tax continues until paid. False or fraudulent declarations under Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63 attract a penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax. Criminal taxation under Criminal Law Article 201 arises for tax evasion exceeding RMB 50,000 and representing more than 10% of the tax payable; imprisonment ranges from 3 to 7 years for aggravated evasion. Also, non-filing or under-withholding on outbound payments may expose the director to personal exit restrictions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% statutory withholding on dividends paid by a Chinese-resident enterprise to a non-resident enterprise, unless reduced under an applicable bilateral Double Taxation Agreement (commonly to 5% for a beneficial owner holding at least 25% capital, or 10% in portfolio cases).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To claim treaty relief, the non-resident recipient must provide the Chinese withholding agent with: (1) a valid Tax Residency Certificate (TRC) issued by the foreign tax authority in the year of payment; (2) a beneficial ownership self-declaration and supporting substance evidence (board minutes, employees, offices, contracts, bank accounts in the residence jurisdiction); and (3) the underlying loan, royalty, or shareholding documentation. The withholding agent files the non-resident tax treaty benefit application/declaration on the e-Tax portal and applies the reduced treaty rate at the source. All TRC and substance records must be retained for at least 5 years for inspection; if the tax authority denies beneficial ownership, the full 10% statutory withholding is recaptured, plus late surcharge interest and possible penalties.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory CIT withholding is 10%; treaty rates under most Chinese DTAs are 10%, but selected treaties reduce royalties for industrial/commercial/equipment payments to 5% or 7.5%. Interest: statutory CIT withholding is 10%; treaty rates commonly range from 5% to 10%, and some DTAs exempt interest paid to government or financial institutions. VAT and any turnover taxes may apply separately to royalties; withholding of CIT must not be confused with VAT collection. Same treaty-relief documentation requirements apply to both interest and royalties.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: CNY thresholds: contemporaneous Local File documentation is mandatory where annual related-party transactions exceed: RMB 200 million for tangible asset transfers; RMB 100 million for intangible asset transfers; RMB 100 million for financial asset transfers, and RMB 40 million for other related-party transactions. Master File is mandatory when aggregate related-party transactions reach RMB 1 billion. Country-by-Country Report is required for MNE groups with consolidated revenue of RMB 5.5 billion or more in the preceding year.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: China does not have UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations in the same statutory form, but Chinese tax law embeds a substance-over-form and General Anti-Avoidance Rule (GAAR) under CIT Law Article 47 and related circulars. For the foreign market-entry consultancy JV, Core Income-Generating Activities (CIGA) such as personnel decision-making, client contract execution, risk assumption, invoice issuance, and strategic management must be genuinely performed in China. A shell company without economic substance will be denied treaty benefits and may be recharacterized as tax fraud or treaty abuse.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The JV omits overseas market-entry consultancy fees received through Wise B2B or bank wire, uses forged invoices from nominal service providers to inflate deductible costs, and under-declares taxable profit in the annual CIT return.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: PRC Tax Collection Administration Law Article 63: confiscate illegal gains, impose a penalty of 50% to 500% of the evaded tax, and recover unpaid tax and surcharge. PRC Criminal Law Article 201: criminal tax evasion applies where the evaded amount is RMB 50,000 or more and exceeds 10% of the tax payable; punishments range from up to 3 years imprisonment for relatively large evasion to 3-7 years for huge evasion plus fines.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil under PRC Company Law Article 23 where a director or controlling shareholder abusing corporate personality causes tax evasion; directors are jointly and severally liable for civil restitution of evaded tax, interest and penalties. Personal travel bans and exit restrictions are imposed by the tax authority under the Exit-Entry Administration Law when material tax is due. Directors face criminal imprisonment and personal asset confiscation for organizing offshore accounts or false invoicing.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The JV is a paper company with no office, employees, client-facing staff or core profit-generating activities in China, and it routes dividends, service fees, or royalties through a tax-haven intermediate company solely to claim a reduced 5% DTA dividend/royalty withholding rate.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Article 47 (GAAR), SAT Announcement 2012 No. 30 and 2018 No. 9 on beneficial ownership; denial of treaty benefits and recapture of the under-withheld tax at the 10% statutory rate, plus late-payment surcharge, interest, and potential administrative penalty. The scheme may be recharacterized as dividend distribution or taxable income in China.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and ultimate beneficial owners who erode the separate corporate form to avoid taxation are personally liable under civil veil-piercing for unpaid withholding taxes and surcharges; they are blacklisted with exit bans and travel restrictions. Criminal liability may arise under Criminal Law Article 191 (money laundering) or Article 201 (tax evasion) where the conduit arrangement involves fraudulent concealment, with imprisonment up to 7 years and asset restitution.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The JV invoices foreign affiliates at below-arm's-length rates for market-entry consultancy, lends funds interest-free, pays excessive royalties to the overseas parent, and fails to prepare Local File / Master File despite exceeding the statutory related-party transaction thresholds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: CIT Law Article 41 empowers adjustment to the arm's-length result; CIT Law Article 48 and Tax Collection Administration Law impose interest on the tax underpaid at the benchmark loan rate plus 5 percentage points. Failure to provide contemporaneous documentation may result in deemed assessment, penalties under Tax Collection Administration Law Articles 44 and 62, and a special tax adjustment look-back of up to 10 years under Article 86.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: If directors intentionally engineer transaction prices, false contracts, or sham cost-sharing arrangements to strip Chinese profits, the tax authority can pursue personal liability by lifting the veil; unpaid adjusted tax, interest and penalties trigger blacklisting and an exit ban. Directors who create fictitious cross-border service arrangements may be criminally prosecuted for tax evasion under Criminal Law Article 201, with imprisonment up to 7 years and personal civil restitution for the full tax leakage.
